title: Shesha-khanda, part 2 (portion 47)
html:
The end of the section "The Lord's Journey to the South": Panchavati; Ranganatha and Trimalla Bhatta; the meeting with Paramananda Puri and the prophecy of Madhavendra Puri. The section "The Lord Sees Vrindavana": the deliverance of the seven palms, Setubandha, the return to Puri; Nrisimhananda paves a road in his mind; the journey to Mathura through Kashi and Prayaga, the meeting with Rupa and Sanatana; the brahmana Krishnadasa and his account of the twelve forests

Raga shri; disha: "He takes away sins, torments and the fear of Yama. Glory to the son of Shachi, glory, glory!"

তবে মহাপ্রভু সেই আনন্দ-কৌতুকে ।
চলিতে আনন্দ দেহ ভরিল পুলকে ॥ ১১৫ ॥

tabe mahāprabhu sei ānanda-kautuke |
calite ānanda deha bharila pulake || 115 ||

tabe — then; mahaprabhu — Mahaprabhu; sei ananda-kautuke — in that joyful play; chalite — as He walks; ananda — in bliss; deha bharila pulake — the body was filled with thrill

115Then Mahaprabhu, in that joyful play,
walks on — and His body in bliss was filled with thrill.

এইমতে ক্রমে ক্রমে পথে চলি' যায় ।
গোদাবরী করি' পঞ্চবটীতে সান্ধায় ॥ ১১৬ ॥

eimate krame krame pathe cali' yāẏa |
godābarī kari' pañcabaṭīte sāndhāẏa || 116 ||

eimate — thus; krame krame — step by step; pathe chali yaya — goes along the road; godavari kari — by way of the Godavari; panchavatite sandhaya — enters Panchavati

116Thus, step by step, He walks along the road
and by way of the Godavari enters Panchavati1.

এই মহা-পুণ্যতীর্থ পঞ্চবটী নাম ।
যাহাতে আছিলা সীতা লক্ষ্মণ শ্রীরাম ॥ ১১৭ ॥

ei mahā-puṇyatīrtha pañcabaṭī nāma |
yāhāte āchilā sītā lakṣmaṇa śrīrāma || 117 ||

ei maha-punya-tirtha — this great holy place; panchavati nama — named Panchavati; yahate achhila — where lived; sita lakshmana shrirama — Sita, Lakshmana, Sri Rama

117This great holy place named Panchavati —
there Sita, Lakshmana and Sri Rama lived.

পঞ্চবটী দেখি' প্রভু প্রেমে অচেতন ।
শ্রীরাম লক্ষ্মণ বলি' ডাকে ঘন ঘন ॥ ১১৮ ॥

pañcabaṭī dekhi' prabhu preme acetana |
śrīrāma lakṣmaṇa bali' ḍāke ghana ghana || 118 ||

panchavati dekhi — seeing Panchavati; prabhu preme achetana — the Lord senseless in prema; shrirama lakshmana bali — saying "Sri Rama! Lakshmana!"; dake ghana ghana — calls again and again

118Seeing Panchavati, the Lord lost consciousness in prema
and again and again calls: "Sri Rama! Lakshmana!"

এইখানে কুঁড়েঘর বান্ধিলা লক্ষ্মণ ।
মৃগী মারিবারে রাম করিলা গমন ॥ ১১৯ ॥

eikhāne kuṁṛeghara bāndhilā lakṣmaṇa |
mṛgī māribāre rāma karilā gamana || 119 ||

eikhane — here; kundeghara bandhila lakshmana — Lakshmana built a hut; mrigi maribare — to kill the deer; rama karila gamana — Rama went

119"Here Lakshmana built a hut;
from here Rama went to kill the deer.

শ্রীরাম-উদ্দেশে পাছে চলিলা লক্ষ্মণ ।
এইখানে সীতা হরি' নিলেক রাবণ ॥ ১২০ ॥

śrīrāma-uddeśe pāche calilā lakṣmaṇa |
eikhāne sītā hari' nileka rābaṇa || 120 ||

shrirama-uddeshe — in search of Sri Rama; pachhe chalila lakshmana — Lakshmana went after; eikhane — here; sita hari nileka ravana — Ravana carried off Sita

120After Sri Rama went Lakshmana —
and here Ravana carried off Sita."

ইহা বলি' কান্দে প্রভু প্রেমায় বিহ্বল ।
মার্ মার্ বোলে ক্ষণে বোলে ধর্ ধর্ ॥ ১২১ ॥

ihā bali' kānde prabhu premāẏa bihbala |
mār mār bole kṣaṇe bole dhar dhar || 121 ||

iha bali — saying this; kande prabhu — the Lord weeps; premaya vihvala — overcome with prema; mar mar bole — cries "strike, strike"; kshane bole dhar dhar — now cries "seize, seize"

121Saying this, the Lord weeps, overcome with prema;
now He cries: "Strike! Strike!", now He cries: "Seize him! Seize him!"

লক্ষ্মণ লক্ষ্মণ বলি' ডাকে উভরায় ।
সীতা সঙরিয়া কান্দে অবশ-হিয়ায় ॥ ১২২ ॥

lakṣmaṇa lakṣmaṇa bali' ḍāke ubharāẏa |
sītā saṅariẏā kānde abaśa-hiẏāẏa || 122 ||

lakshmana lakshmana bali — saying "Lakshmana! Lakshmana!"; dake ubharaya — calls loudly; sita sanariya — remembering Sita; kande abasha-hiyaya — weeps with a fainting heart

122Loudly He calls: "Lakshmana! Lakshmana!" —
and remembering Sita, weeps with a fainting heart2.

সঙ্গের সঙ্গতিগণ প্রবোধিতে নারে ।
আপনেই মহাপ্রভু আপনা সম্বরে ॥ ১২৩ ॥

saṅgera saṅgatigaṇa prabodhite nāre |
āpanei mahāprabhu āpanā sambare || 123 ||

sangera sangatigana — the companions with Him; prabodhite nare — cannot console; apanei mahaprabhu — Mahaprabhu Himself; apana sambare — composes Himself

123The companions who were with Him cannot console Him;
Mahaprabhu Himself regains His composure.

তবে আর দিন পথে চলিলা ঠাকুর ।
ক্রমে ক্রমে উত্তরিলা কাবেরীর তীর ॥ ১২৪ ॥

tabe āra dina pathe calilā ṭhākura |
krame krame uttarilā kāberīra tīra || 124 ||

tabe ara dina — then on another day; pathe chalila thakura — the Thakura went along the road; krame krame — little by little; uttarila kaverira tira — reached the bank of the Kaveri

124Then, on another day, the Thakura went along the road
and little by little reached the bank of the Kaveri.

কাবেরীর কূলে দেখে শ্রীরঙ্গনাথ ।
দেখিয়া প্রেমায় নাচে নিজজন-সাথ ॥ ১২৫ ॥

kāberīra kūle dekhe śrīraṅganātha |
dekhiẏā premāẏa nāce nijajana-sātha || 125 ||

kaverira kule — on the bank of the Kaveri; dekhe shriranganatha — sees Sri Ranganatha; dekhiya — seeing; premaya nache — dances in prema; nijajana-satha — with His own people

125On the bank of the Kaveri He sees Sri Ranganatha;
seeing Him, He dances in prema with His own people.

তথায় ত্রিমল্ল ভট্ট ঠাকুরে দেখিয়া ।
নিরীখয়ে গৌর-অঙ্গ বিস্মিত হইয়া ॥ ১২৬ ॥

tathāẏa trimalla bhaṭṭa ṭhākure dekhiẏā |
nirīkhaẏe gaura-aṅga bismita haiẏā || 126 ||

tathaya — there; trimalla bhatta — Trimalla Bhatta; thakure dekhiya — seeing the Thakura; nirikhaye gaura-anga — gazes at the golden body; vismita haiya — in amazement

126There Trimalla Bhatta, seeing the Thakura,
gazes in amazement at the golden body.

দেহের কিরণ আর প্রেমার আরম্ভ ।
কদম্বকেশর জিনি' পুলক-কদম্ব ॥ ১২৭ ॥

dehera kiraṇa āra premāra ārambha |
kadambakeśara jini' pulaka-kadamba || 127 ||

dehera kirana — the radiance of the body; ara premara arambha — and the surges of prema; kadamba-keshara jini — surpassing kadamba filaments; pulaka-kadamba — clusters of hairs standing on end

127The radiance of His body and the surges of prema!
His hairs standing on end in thrill outdo the filaments of the kadamba.

সর্বলোক জিনি' তনু যেহেন সুমেরু ।
প্রেম-ফল-ফুলে ফলিয়াছে কল্পতরু ॥ ১২৮ ॥

sarbaloka jini' tanu yehena sumeru |
prema-phala-phule phaliẏāche kalpataru || 128 ||

sarvaloka jini — surpassing all people; tanu yehena sumeru — the body like Sumeru; prema-phala-phule — with fruits and flowers of prema; phaliyachhe kalpataru — the wish-fulfilling tree bears fruit

128His body towers over all people like Sumeru —
a wish-fulfilling tree laden with the fruits and flowers of prema.

হরি হরি বলি' ডাকে অতি উচ্চনাদে ।
দেখিয়া চৌদিগ ভরি' সব লোক কান্দে ॥ ১২৯ ॥

hari hari bali' ḍāke ati uccanāde |
dekhiẏā caudiga bhari' saba loka kānde || 129 ||

hari hari bali — saying "Hari! Hari!"; dake ati uchchanade — calls very loudly; dekhiya — seeing; chaudiga bhari — filling all sides; saba loka kande — all the people weep

129"Hari! Hari!" He calls in a loud voice;
seeing this, all the people who crowd round on every side weep.

এছন দেখিয়া সে ত্রিমল্ল ভট্টাচার্য ।
কৌতুকে সকল কথা জানিল আশ্চর্য ॥ ১৩০ ॥

echana dekhiẏā se trimalla bhaṭṭācārya |
kautuke sakala kathā jānila āścarya || 130 ||

echhana dekhiya — seeing such things; se trimalla bhattacharya — that Trimalla Bhattacharya; kautuke — in wonder; sakala katha janila — grasped the whole matter; ashcharya — marvellous

130Seeing such things, that Trimalla Bhattacharya
in wonder grasped the whole marvellous matter:

এই সেই ভগবান্ কভু নহে আন ।
নিশ্চয় জানিল এই সর্বজন-প্রাণ ॥ ১৩১ ॥

ei sei bhagabān kabhu nahe āna |
niścaẏa jānila ei sarbajana-prāṇa || 131 ||

ei sei bhagavan — this is Bhagavan Himself; kabhu nahe ana — never anyone else; nishchaya janila — he knew for certain; ei sarvajana-prana — this is the life of all

131"This is Bhagavan Himself — no one else!"
He knew for certain: this is the life of all beings.

এতেক জানিয়া সে ত্রিমল্ল-ভট্টরায় ।
আপন আশ্রমে সে প্রভুরে লঞা যায় ॥ ১৩২ ॥

eteka jāniẏā se trimalla-bhaṭṭarāẏa |
āpana āśrame se prabhure lañā yāẏa || 132 ||

eteka janiya — knowing this; se trimalla-bhattaraya — that Trimalla Bhatta Raya; apana ashrame — to his own dwelling; se prabhure lanya yaya — takes the Lord

132Knowing this, Trimalla Bhatta Raya
takes the Lord to his own dwelling3.

তার বাড়ী গেলা প্রভু প্রথম আষাঢ়ে ।
সর্বজীবে কৃষ্ণভক্তি দিনে দিনে বাঢ়ে ॥ ১৩২+১ ॥

tāra bāṛī gelā prabhu prathama āṣāṛhe |
sarbajībe kṛṣṇabhakti dine dine bāṛhe || 132+1 ||

tara badi gela prabhu — the Lord went to his house; prathama ashadhe — at the start of Ashadha; sarvajive — in all beings; krishna-bhakti — devotion to Krishna; dine dine badhe — grows day by day

132+1The Lord came to his house at the beginning of [the month of] Ashadha;
in all beings devotion to Krishna grows from day to day.

সেইখানে রথযাত্রা কৈল দরশন ।
রথ-অগ্রে নৃত্য কৈল শ্রীশচীনন্দন ॥ ১৩২+২ ॥

seikhāne rathayātrā kaila daraśana |
ratha-agre nṛtya kaila śrīśacīnandana || 132+2 ||

seikhane — there; ratha-yatra kaila darashana — He saw the Ratha-yatra; ratha-agre — before the chariot; nritya kaila — danced; shri-shachinandana — Sri Shachinandana

132+2There He saw the Ratha-yatra,
and Sri Shachinandana danced before the chariot.

শ্রাবণে থাকিয়া প্রভু করিল ঝুলনা ।
নাম-গুণ-সংকীর্তনে নাচে সর্বজনা ॥ ১৩২+৩ ॥

śrābaṇe thākiẏā prabhu karila jhulanā |
nāma-guṇa-saṃkīrtane nāce sarbajanā || 132+3 ||

shravane thakiya — staying in Shravana; prabhu karila jhulana — the Lord celebrated the swing festival; nama-guna-sankirtane — in the sankirtana of names and qualities; nache sarvajana — all dance

132+3Staying [there] in Shravana, the Lord celebrated the swing festival;
all dance in the sankirtana of [the Lord's] names and qualities.

ভাদ্রে থাকিয়া কৃষ্ণ-জন্মযাত্রা কৈল ।
গোপবেশে গোরাচাঁদের বহু নৃত্য হৈল ॥ ১৩২+৪ ॥

bhādre thākiẏā kṛṣṇa-janmayātrā kaila |
gopabeśe gorācāṁdera bahu nṛtya haila || 132+4 ||

bhadre thakiya — staying in Bhadra; krishna-janma-yatra kaila — celebrated the festival of Krishna's birth; gopa-veshe — in cowherd dress; gorachandera bahu nritya haila — Gorachand danced much

132+4Staying in Bhadra, He celebrated the festival of Krishna's birth:
much did Gorachand dance in the dress of a cowherd.

আশ্বিনে থাকিয়া প্রভু শচীর নন্দন ।
ভক্তগণ লঞা করে নাম-সংকীর্তন ॥ ১৩২+৫ ॥

āśbine thākiẏā prabhu śacīra nandana |
bhaktagaṇa lañā kare nāma-saṃkīrtana || 132+5 ||

ashvine thakiya — staying in Ashvina; prabhu shachira nandana — the Lord, Shachi's son; bhaktagana lanya — with the devotees; kare nama-sankirtana — performs sankirtana of the Name

132+5Staying in Ashvina, the Lord, the son of Shachi,
performs sankirtana of the Name with the devotees4.

তার প্রেমে মহাপ্রভু তার বশ হঞা ।
চাতুর্মাস্য বঞ্চিল পরমপ্রীতি পাঞা ॥ ১৩৩ ॥

tāra preme mahāprabhu tāra baśa hañā |
cāturmāsya bañcila paramaprīti pāñā || 133 ||

tara preme — by his love; mahaprabhu tara basha hanya — Mahaprabhu, coming under his sway; chaturmasya vanchila — spent the chaturmasya; parama-priti panya — finding the highest joy

133Conquered by [Trimalla's] love, Mahaprabhu came under his sway
and, filled with the highest joy, spent the chaturmasya [with him].

চাতুর্মাস্য বঞ্চি' প্রভু চলিলা তুরিতে ।
পথে দেখা পরমানন্দপুরীর সহিতে ॥ ১৩৪ ॥

cāturmāsya bañci' prabhu calilā turite |
pathe dekhā paramānandapurīra sahite || 134 ||

chaturmasya vanchi — having spent the chaturmasya; prabhu chalila turite — the Lord quickly set out; pathe dekha — on the way a meeting; paramananda-purira sahite — with Paramananda Puri

134Having spent the chaturmasya, the Lord quickly set out [again]
and on the way met Paramananda Puri5.

দোঁহে দোঁহা দেখি' তুষ্ট হৈলা দুইজন ।
নিরখিতে দোঁহাকার ঝরয়ে নয়ন ॥ ১৩৫ ॥

doṁhe doṁhā dekhi' tuṣṭa hailā duijana |
nirakhite doṁhākāra jharaẏe naẏana || 135 ||

donhe donha dekhi — seeing each other; tushta haila duijana — both rejoiced; nirakhite — as they gaze; donhakara jharaye nayana — tears flow from the eyes of both

135Seeing each other, both rejoiced;
they gaze at each other, and tears flow from the eyes of both.

দেখিতে পরমানন্দপুরীর স্মরণে ।
গুরু মাধবেন্দ্রপুরী যে কৈল বচনে ॥ ১৩৬ ॥

dekhite paramānandapurīra smaraṇe |
guru mādhabendrapurī ye kaila bacane || 136 ||

dekhite — as he looked; paramananda-purira smarane — Paramananda Puri remembered; guru madhavendra-puri — the guru Madhavendra Puri; ye kaila vachane — what he had said

136Looking [at the Lord], Paramananda Puri remembered
what his guru Madhavendra Puri had said:

কলেঃ প্রথমসন্ধ্যায়াং লক্ষ্মীকান্তো ভবিষ্যতি ।
দারুব্রহ্মসমীপস্থঃ সন্ন্যাসী গৌরবিগ্রহঃ ॥ ১৩৭ ॥

kaleḥ prathamasandhyāẏāṃ lakṣmīkānto bhabiṣyati |
dārubrahmasamīpasthaḥ sannyāsī gaurabigrahaḥ || 137 ||

kaleh — of Kali; prathama-sandhyayam — in the first twilight; lakshmi-kantah — the Lord of Lakshmi; bhavishyati — will appear; daru-brahma-samipasthah — dwelling near the Daru-brahman; sannyasi — a sannyasi; gaura-vigrahah — with a golden form

137"In the first twilight of Kali the Lord of Lakshmi will appear —
a sannyasi with a golden body, dwelling near the Daru-brahman"6.

কলিযুগে সঙ্কীর্তন-ধর্ম রাখিবারে ।
জনমিব কৃষ্ণ প্রথম সন্ধ্যার ভিতরে ॥ ১৩৮ ॥

kaliyuge saṅkīrtana-dharma rākhibāre |
janamiba kṛṣṇa prathama sandhyāra bhitare || 138 ||

kaliyuge — in the Kali-yuga; sankirtana-dharma — the dharma of sankirtana; rakhibare — to establish; janamiba krishna — Krishna will be born; prathama sandhyara bhitare — within the first twilight

138"To establish in the Kali-yuga the dharma of sankirtana
Krishna will be born in the first twilight [of this yuga].

গৌর দীর্ঘ-কলেবর বাহু জানুসম ।
সিংহ-গ্রীব গজ-স্কন্ধ কমললোচন ॥ ১৩৯ ॥

gaura dīrgha-kalebara bāhu jānusama |
siṃha-grība gaja-skandha kamalalocana || 139 ||

gaura — golden; dirgha-kalevara — tall of body; bahu janusama — arms to the knees; simha-griva — a lion's neck; gaja-skandha — an elephant's shoulders; kamala-lochana — lotus eyes

139Golden, tall of body, arms reaching to the knees,
a neck like a lion's, shoulders like an elephant's, lotus eyes.

করুণাসাগর প্রভু প্রেমার আবাস ।
নিজ করুণায় দয়া করিব প্রকাশ ॥ ১৪০ ॥

karuṇāsāgara prabhu premāra ābāsa |
nija karuṇāẏa daẏā kariba prakāśa || 140 ||

karuna-sagara prabhu — the Lord, an ocean of compassion; premara avasa — the abode of prema; nija karunaya — out of His own compassion; daya kariba prakasha — will show mercy

140The Lord, an ocean of compassion, the abode of prema,
out of His own mercy will show grace.

মোর ভাগ্য নাহি মুঞি দেখিব নয়নে ।
তোর দেখা হৈলে মোরে করিহ স্মরণে ॥ ১৪১ ॥

mora bhāgya nāhi muñi dekhiba naẏane |
tora dekhā haile more kariha smaraṇe || 141 ||

mora bhagya nahi — I have no fortune; munyi dekhiba nayane — that I should see [Him] with my eyes; tora dekha haile — when you see [Him]; more kariha smarane — remember me

141I have not the fortune to see Him with my own eyes;
when you see Him, remember me."

সেই এই গুরুবাক্য মনেতে পড়িল ।
এই সেই ভগবান্ নিশ্চয় জানিল ॥ ১৪২ ॥

sei ei gurubākya manete paṛila |
ei sei bhagabān niścaẏa jānila || 142 ||

sei ei guru-vakya — these words of the guru; manete padila — came to mind; ei sei bhagavan — this is Bhagavan Himself; nishchaya janila — he knew for certain

142These words of his guru came to his mind,
and he knew for certain: this is Bhagavan Himself.

মাধবেন্দ্র বলি' বলি' করিল স্মরণ ।
তবে ত আনন্দ-মনে করয়ে ক্রন্দন ॥ ১৪২+১ ॥

mādhabendra bali' bali' karila smaraṇa |
tabe ta ānanda-mane karaẏe krandana || 142+1 ||

madhavendra bali bali — repeating "Madhavendra"; karila smarana — he remembered; tabe ta — then; ananda-mane — with joy at heart; karaye krandana — weeps

142+1"Madhavendra!" he repeated, remembering [his guru],
and wept with joy in his heart.

মাধবেন্দ্র-কীর্তন শুনিয়া প্রভু নাচে ।
হরি হরি বলি' ভক্ত নাচে কাছে কাছে ॥ ১৪২+২ ॥

mādhabendra-kīrtana śuniẏā prabhu nāce |
hari hari bali' bhakta nāce kāche kāche || 142+2 ||

madhavendra-kirtana shuniya — hearing the glorification of Madhavendra; prabhu nache — the Lord dances; hari hari bali — saying "Hari! Hari!"; bhakta nache kachhe kachhe — the devotees dance close by

142+2Hearing him glorify Madhavendra, the Lord dances,
and the devotees, crying "Hari! Hari!", dance close by.

ক্ষণে হুহুঙ্কার দেই পরম আনন্দে ।
মাধবেন্দ্র বলি' প্রভু প্রেমানন্দে কান্দে ॥ ১৪২+৩ ॥

kṣaṇe huhuṅkāra dei parama ānande |
mādhabendra bali' prabhu premānande kānde || 142+3 ||

kshane — now and again; huhunkara dei — gives loud shouts; parama anande — in supreme bliss; madhavendra bali — saying "Madhavendra"; prabhu premanande kande — the Lord weeps in the bliss of prema

142+3Now and again He gives loud shouts in supreme bliss;
"Madhavendra!" cries the Lord and weeps in the bliss of prema:

এতদিনে মোর সন্ন্যাস সফল হইল ।
মাধবেন্দ্র-ধ্বনি মোর কর্ণে প্রবেশিল ॥ ১৪২+৪ ॥

etadine mora sannyāsa saphala haila |
mādhabendra-dhbani mora karṇe prabeśila || 142+4 ||

etadine — today at last; mora sannyasa saphala haila — My sannyasa has borne fruit; madhavendra-dhvani — the sound of Madhavendra's [name]; mora karne praveshila — entered My ears

142+4"Today My sannyasa has borne fruit:
the name of Madhavendra has entered My ears"7.

দেখি' পরণাম করে পরমানন্দপুরী ।
কি করহ বলি' প্রভু তোলে হাথে ধরি' ॥ ১৪৩ ॥

dekhi' paraṇāma kare paramānandapurī |
ki karaha bali' prabhu tole hāthe dhari' || 143 ||

dekhi — seeing; paranama kare paramananda-puri — Paramananda Puri bows; ki karaha bali — saying "what are you doing?"; prabhu tole hathe dhari — the Lord lifts him, taking his hands

143Seeing [this], Paramananda Puri bows;
"What are you doing?" says the Lord and lifts him up by the hands.

গাঢ় আলিঙ্গন কৈল পরমসন্তোষে ।
চলিলা ঠাকুর কহে এ লোচনদাসে ॥ ১৪৪ ॥

gāṛha āliṅgana kaila paramasantoṣe |
calilā ṭhākura kahe e locanadāse || 144 ||

gadha alingana kaila — embraced tightly; parama-santoshe — in great joy; chalila thakura — the Thakura went on; kahe e lochanadase — says this Lochana Dasa

144In great joy He embraced him tightly,
and the Thakura went on, says this Lochana Dasa.

The Lord Sees Vrindavana

Summary by Srila Bhaktisiddhanta Sarasvati. On the way to Setubandha Sriman Mahaprabhu showed the lila of delivering the seven palms. The ancient story of the seven palms [is this]: seven gandharvas, cursed by a sage, became trees; now, by the touch of the Lord, they attained liberation. Arriving at Setubandha, He, absorbed in prema, chanted the names of Rama, Lakshmana, Sita, Hanuman and others; then, having spent the chaturmasya on the bank of the Godavari, He returned again to Utkala, to Alalanatha. There He accepted as His own a devotee named Vishnudasa and, coming [to Purushottama], He stayed there and [spent] several months with the devotees in the bliss of kirtana. After this, setting out to see the Mathura-mandala, He met Rupa and Sanatana. Coming to Mathura, He, together with a devotee named Krishnadasa, absorbed in prema, saw on the eastern and western banks of the Yamuna the twelve forests, the prison of Devaki and Vasudeva, the houses of Kamsa, Ugrasena and others — countless places of Krishna's lilas8.

Raga dhanashi; disha: "Gorachand is my life, Gora is my breath!"

আর অপরূপ কথা শুন সাবধানে ।
পথে চলি' যাইতে সপ্ততাল-বিমোচনে ॥ ১ ॥

āra aparūpa kathā śuna sābadhāne |
pathe cali' yāite saptatāla-bimocane || 1 ||

ara aparupa katha — another wondrous story; shuna savadhane — hear attentively; pathe chali yaite — as He went along the road; sapta-tala-vimochane — about the deliverance of the seven palms

1Hear attentively another wondrous story —
of the deliverance of the seven palms, as [the Lord] went along the road.

সপ্ত তালতরু সেই আছে যে পথেতে ।
দেখি' আচম্বিতে প্রভু লাগিলা হাসিতে ॥ ২ ॥

sapta tālataru sei āche ye pathete |
dekhi' ācambite prabhu lāgilā hāsite || 2 ||

sapta talataru — seven palm trees; sei achhe ye pathete — stand on that road; dekhi — seeing; achambite — suddenly; prabhu lagila hasite — the Lord began to laugh

2Those seven palms stand on that road;
seeing them, the Lord suddenly began to laugh.

ধাঞা গিয়া সপ্ততাল করিলা পরশে ।
জয় জয় জয়ধ্বনি উঠিল আকাশে ॥ ৩ ॥

dhāñā giẏā saptatāla karilā paraśe |
jaẏa jaẏa jaẏadhbani uṭhila ākāśe || 3 ||

dhanya giya — running up; saptatala karila parashe — touched the seven palms; jaya jaya jaya-dhvani — cries of "glory, glory, glory"; uthila akashe — rose in the sky

3Running up, He touched the seven palms —
and in the sky rose cries: "Glory! Glory! Glory!"

মুনিশাপে ছিল সে গন্ধর্ব সাতজন ।
প্রভুর পরশে তারা পাইল মোচন ॥ ৪ ॥

muniśāpe chila se gandharba sātajana |
prabhura paraśe tārā pāila mocana || 4 ||

munishape — by a sage's curse; chhila se gandharva satajana — seven gandharvas had dwelt; prabhura parashe — by the Lord's touch; tara paila mochana — they obtained deliverance

4By a sage's curse seven gandharvas had dwelt [in them];
by the Lord's touch they attained deliverance.

জোড়হস্ত করি' তারা দণ্ডবত কৈল ।
দিব্যদেহ পাইয়া সবে বৈকুণ্ঠে চলিল ॥ ৪+১ ॥

joṛahasta kari' tārā daṇḍabata kaila |
dibyadeha pāiẏā sabe baikuṇṭhe calila || 4+1 ||

joda-hasta kari — joining their palms; tara dandavata kaila — they prostrated themselves; divya-deha paiya — gaining divine bodies; sabe vaikunthe chalila — all went to Vaikuntha

4+1Joining their palms, they prostrated themselves [before Him]
and, gaining divine bodies, all departed for Vaikuntha.

দেখিয়া সকল লোক করে নমস্কার ।
সবে বলে এই ন্যাসী রাম-অবতার ॥ ৪+২ ॥

dekhiẏā sakala loka kare namaskāra |
sabe bale ei nyāsī rāma-abatāra || 4+2 ||

dekhiya — seeing; sakala loka kare namaskara — all the people bow; sabe bale — all say; ei nyasi — this sannyasi; rama-avatara — is the avatara Rama

4+2Seeing this, all the people bow;
all say: "This sannyasi is the avatara Rama"9.

তবে সেই মহাপ্রভু পথে চলি' যায় ।
আনন্দে বিভোল প্রভু হরিগুণ গায় ॥ ৫ ॥

tabe sei mahāprabhu pathe cali' yāẏa |
ānande bibhola prabhu hariguṇa gāẏa || 5 ||

tabe sei mahaprabhu — then Mahaprabhu; pathe chali yaya — goes along the road; anande vibhola prabhu — the Lord, intoxicated with bliss; hari-guna gaya — sings the glories of Hari

5Then Mahaprabhu goes along the road;
intoxicated with bliss, the Lord sings the glories of Hari.

প্রেমার আনন্দে নাহি জানে পথশ্রমে ।
সেতুবন্ধ উত্তরিলা পথে ক্রমে ক্রমে ॥ ৬ ॥

premāra ānande nāhi jāne pathaśrame |
setubandha uttarilā pathe krame krame || 6 ||

premara anande — in the bliss of prema; nahi jane patha-shrame — does not feel the toil of the road; setubandha uttarila — reached Setubandha; pathe krame krame — little by little along the road

6In the bliss of prema He does not feel the weariness of the road
and little by little reached Setubandha.

সেতুবন্ধ গিয়া দেখে রামেশ্বর লিঙ্গ ।
আনন্দে নাচয়ে প্রভু যেন মত্ত সিংহ ॥ ৭ ॥

setubandha giẏā dekhe rāmeśbara liṅga |
ānande nācaẏe prabhu yena matta siṃha || 7 ||

setubandha giya — coming to Setubandha; dekhe rameshvara linga — sees the linga of Rameshvara; anande nachaye prabhu — the Lord dances in bliss; yena matta simha — like a maddened lion

7Coming to Setubandha, He sees the linga of Rameshvara;
the Lord dances in bliss like a maddened lion.

লিঙ্গ-প্রদক্ষিণ করি' করে নমস্কার ।
সেতুবন্ধ দেখি' হরি বোলে বারে বার ॥ ৮ ॥

liṅga-pradakṣiṇa kari' kare namaskāra |
setubandha dekhi' hari bole bāre bāra || 8 ||

linga-pradakshina kari — circumambulating the linga; kare namaskara — bows; setubandha dekhi — seeing Setubandha; hari bole bare bara — cries "Hari" again and again

8Walking round the linga, He bows;
looking at Setubandha, He cries "Hari!" again and again.

অনুরাগে কান্দে ডাকে শ্রীরাম-লক্ষ্মণ ।
কখন আবেশে ডাকে অঙ্গদ হনুমান্ ॥ ৯ ॥

anurāge kānde ḍāke śrīrāma-lakṣmaṇa |
kakhana ābeśe ḍāke aṅgada hanumān || 9 ||

anurage kande — weeps in loving longing; dake shrirama-lakshmana — calls Sri Rama and Lakshmana; kakhana aveshe — at times in His bhava; dake angada hanuman — calls Angada and Hanuman

9In loving longing He weeps and calls: "Sri Rama! Lakshmana!";
at times, in His bhava, He calls: "Angada! Hanuman!"

ক্ষণেকে আবেশে ডাকে সুগ্রীব মোর মিত ।
ক্ষণে বিভীষণ বলি' ডাকে বিপরীত ॥ ১০ ॥

kṣaṇeke ābeśe ḍāke sugrība mora mita |
kṣaṇe bibhīṣaṇa bali' ḍāke biparīta || 10 ||

kshaneke aveshe dake — now in His bhava He calls; sugriva mora mita — "Sugriva, My friend"; kshane vibhishana bali — now saying "Vibhishana"; dake viparita — calls wildly

10Now in His bhava He calls: "Sugriva, My friend!" —
now in a frenzy He calls: "Vibhishana!"

প্রেমায় বিহ্বল দিগ্‌বিদিগ্ নাহি জানে ।
সেতুবন্ধ দেখি' নাচে সব ভক্ত-সনে ॥ ১১ ॥

premāẏa bihbala dig‌bidig nāhi jāne |
setubandha dekhi' nāce saba bhakta-sane || 11 ||

premaya vihvala — overcome with prema; dig-vidig nahi jane — knows not one direction from another; setubandha dekhi — seeing Setubandha; nache saba bhakta-sane — dances with all the devotees

11Overcome with prema, He does not know one direction from another,
and looking at Setubandha He dances with all the devotees10.

এইমতে দিবানিশি পাসরে আপনা ।
লেউটিতে মহাপ্রভুর বাড়িল করুণা ॥ ১২ ॥

eimate dibāniśi pāsare āpanā |
leuṭite mahāprabhura bāṛila karuṇā || 12 ||

eimate — thus; divanishi pasare apana — day and night forgets Himself; leutite — to turn back; mahaprabhura badila karuna — Mahaprabhu's mercy grew

12Thus day and night He forgets Himself;
[at last] Mahaprabhu's mercy grew — to turn back.

এইমতে মহাপ্রভু পথে চলি' আসি' ।
পুনঃ চাতুর্মাস্য গোদাবরী-তীর্থে বসি' ॥ ১৩ ॥

eimate mahāprabhu pathe cali' āsi' |
punaḥ cāturmāsya godābarī-tīrthe basi' || 13 ||

eimate mahaprabhu — thus Mahaprabhu; pathe chali asi — coming along the road [back]; punah chaturmasya — again a chaturmasya; godavari-tirthe basi — staying at the holy Godavari

13So Mahaprabhu, going along the road [back],
again spent a chaturmasya, staying at the holy Godavari11.

পুনরপি উড্রদেশে আইলা ঠাকুর ।
জগন্নাথ-ভাবে প্রেমা বাঢ়িল প্রচুর ॥ ১৪ ॥

punarapi uḍradeśe āilā ṭhākura |
jagannātha-bhābe premā bāṛhila pracura || 14 ||

punarapi — again; udradeshe aila thakura — the Thakura came to the land of the Udras; jagannatha-bhave — in the bhava of Jagannatha; prema badhila prachura — prema grew abundantly

14Again the Thakura came to the land of the Udras;
in the bhava [of meeting] Jagannatha His prema grew beyond measure.

তবে ত দেখিল প্রভু শ্রীআলালনাথ ।
বিষ্ণুদাস উড়িয়াকে কৈল আত্মসাথ ॥ ১৫ ॥

tabe ta dekhila prabhu śrīālālanātha |
biṣṇudāsa uṛiẏāke kaila ātmasātha || 15 ||

tabe ta — then; dekhila prabhu shri-alalanatha — the Lord saw Sri Alalanatha; vishnudasa udiyake — Vishnudasa the Oriya; kaila atmasatha — made His own

15Then the Lord saw Sri Alalanatha
and made Vishnudasa the Oriya His own12.

জগন্নাথ দেখি' প্রভু হইলা কুতুহলী ।
সঘনে তুলিয়া বাহু হরি হরি বলি' ॥ ১৬ ॥

jagannātha dekhi' prabhu hailā kutuhalī |
saghane tuliẏā bāhu hari hari bali' || 16 ||

jagannatha dekhi — seeing Jagannatha; prabhu haila kutuhali — the Lord was filled with joyful excitement; saghane tuliya bahu — again and again raising His arms; hari hari bali — crying "Hari! Hari!"

16Seeing Jagannatha, the Lord was filled with joyful excitement:
again and again raising His arms, He cries "Hari! Hari!"

পুরুষোত্তমে আসি' প্রভু আছে মহাসুখে ।
কহয়ে লোচন এ আনন্দ বড় লোকে ॥ ১৭ ॥

puruṣottame āsi' prabhu āche mahāsukhe |
kahaẏe locana e ānanda baṛa loke || 17 ||

purushottame asi — coming to Purushottama; prabhu achhe maha-sukhe — the Lord stays in great happiness; kahaye lochana — Lochana tells; e ananda bada loke — this is a great joy to people

17Coming to Purushottama, the Lord stays in great happiness;
Lochana tells it — a great joy it is to people.

Raga varadi; the tune "dhulakhela"

এখন কহিব কথা, শুন গোরা-গুণগাথা,
ত্রিজগতে অতি অনুপাম ।
মনে মনে বান্ধে আলি, মুকুতা-প্রবাল ঢালি',
সন্ন্যাসী নৃসিংহানন্দ নাম ॥ ১৮ ॥

ekhana kahiba kathā, śuna gorā-guṇagāthā,
trijagate ati anupāma |
mane mane bāndhe āli, mukutā-prabāla ḍhāli',
sannyāsī nṛsiṃhānanda nāma || 18 ||

ekhana kahiba katha — now I shall tell a story; shuna gora-guna-gatha — hear the song of Gora's virtues; trijagate ati anupama — peerless in the three worlds; mane mane bandhe ali — in his mind builds an embankment; mukuta-pravala dhali — strewing pearls and coral; sannyasi nrisimhananda nama — a sannyasi named Nrisimhananda

18Now I shall tell a story — hear the song of the virtues of Gora,
peerless in the three worlds.
In his mind he built an embankment, strewing it with pearls and coral —
a sannyasi named Nrisimhananda.

সুবর্ণ-মণি-মাণিক্যে, দিব্যরত্ন চারিদিগে,
মনে মনে বান্ধিল জাঙ্গাল ।
মথুরা পর্যন্ত দিয়া, কৃষ্ণে সমর্পিব ইহা,
হেনকালে প্রত্যাসন্ন কাল ॥ ১৯ ॥

subarṇa-maṇi-māṇikye, dibyaratna cāridige,
mane mane bāndhila jāṅgāla |
mathurā paryanta diẏā, kṛṣṇe samarpiba ihā,
henakāle pratyāsanna kāla || 19 ||

suvarna-mani-manikye — with gold, gems and rubies; divya-ratna charidige — with divine jewels on all sides; mane mane bandhila jangala — in his mind built a raised road; mathura paryanta diya — laying it as far as Mathura; krishne samarpiba iha — I will offer it to Krishna; henakale — at that time; pratyasanna kala — [his] hour drew near

19With gold, gems and rubies, with divine jewels on every side,
in his mind he built a road.
"Taking it as far as Mathura, I will offer it to Krishna" —
but just then his hour drew near.

না হৈল জাঙ্গাল সায়, দুঃখ রহিল হিয়ায়,
মনে মনে করে অনুতাপ ।
কানাইর নাটশালা পর্যন্ত, হইল জাঙ্গাল অন্ত,
সন্ন্যাসীর বৈকুণ্ঠ হৈল লাভ ॥ ২০ ॥

nā haila jāṅgāla sāẏa, duḥkha rahila hiẏāẏa,
mane mane kare anutāpa |
kānāira nāṭaśālā paryanta, haila jāṅgāla anta,
sannyāsīra baikuṇṭha haila lābha || 20 ||

na haila jangala saya — the road was not completed; duhkha rahila hiyaya — grief remained in the heart; mane mane kare anutapa — he laments within himself; kanaira natashala paryanta — as far as Kanai's Natashala; haila jangala anta — the road came to an end; sannyasira vaikuntha haila labha — the sannyasi attained Vaikuntha

20The road was not finished, and grief remained in his heart;
he lamented within himself.
As far as Kanai's Natashala the road reached, and there it ended —
and the sannyasi attained Vaikuntha13.

এ কথা আছিল চিতে, চলে প্রভু আচম্বিতে,
না জানি কোথারে চলি' যায় ।
ক্রমে ক্রমে চলি' যাইতে, কানাইর নাটশালা হৈতে,
পুনঃ লেউটিলা গোরারায় ॥ ২১ ॥

e kathā āchila cite, cale prabhu ācambite,
nā jāni kothāre cali' yāẏa |
krame krame cali' yāite, kānāira nāṭaśālā haite,
punaḥ leuṭilā gorārāẏa || 21 ||

e katha achhila chite — this was in his heart; chale prabhu achambite — the Lord suddenly sets out; na jani kothare chali yaya — no one knows where He goes; krame krame chali yaite — going step by step; kanaira natashala haite — from Kanai's Natashala; punah leutila goraraya — Gora Raya turned back again

21This had been in his heart. The Lord suddenly set out —
no one knows where He is going.
Going on step by step, from Kanai's Natashala
Gora Raya turned back again.

এ কথা বেকত নহে, পরমানন্দপুরী কহে,
কহ প্রভু ইহার কারণ ।
আদ্যোপান্ত যত কথা, তাহারে কহিল তথা,
মনঃকথা-সিদ্ধির কারণ ॥ ২২ ॥

e kathā bekata nahe, paramānandapurī kahe,
kaha prabhu ihāra kāraṇa |
ādyopānta yata kathā, tāhāre kahila tathā,
manaḥkathā-siddhira kāraṇa || 22 ||

e katha bekata nahe — this matter is not clear; paramananda-puri kahe — Paramananda Puri says; kaha prabhu ihara karana — tell, Lord, the reason for this; adyopanta yata katha — the whole story from beginning to end; tahare kahila tatha — He told him then; manah-katha-siddhira karana — the reason: fulfilment of a mental wish

22The matter was not understood. Paramananda Puri says:
"Tell us, Lord, the reason for this."
Everything from beginning to end He then told him:
the reason was the fulfilment of a wish of the mind.

পুরুষোত্তম আদি অন্ত, মথুরাপুরী পর্যন্ত,
স্বর্ণ মণি মাণিক্যে দিব আলি ।
সন্ন্যাসীর এমন হিয়া, এ মোর জাঙ্গাল দিয়া,
চলি' যাবে গোরা বনমালী ॥ ২৩ ॥

puruṣottama ādi anta, mathurāpurī paryanta,
sbarṇa maṇi māṇikye diba āli |
sannyāsīra emana hiẏā, e mora jāṅgāla diẏā,
cali' yābe gorā banamālī || 23 ||

purushottama adi anta — from Purushottama to the end; mathurapuri paryanta — as far as Mathura; svarna mani manikye diba ali — I will lay an embankment of gold, gems and rubies; sannyasira emana hiya — such was the sannyasi's heart; e mora jangala diya — along this road of mine; chali yabe gora vanamali — Gora, wearer of the forest garland, will go

23"From Purushottama all the way to Mathura
I will pave an embankment with gold, gems and rubies" —
such was the sannyasi's heart: "Along this road of mine
Gora, who wears the forest garland, will go."

শুন শুন সর্বজন, সাবধানে দিয়া মন,
শ্রীগোরাচাঁদের পরকাশ ।
মনঃকথা নৃসিংহানন্দ, সিদ্ধ কৈল গৌরচন্দ্র,
গুণ গায় এ লোচনদাস ॥ ২৪ ॥

śuna śuna sarbajana, sābadhāne diẏā mana,
śrīgorācāṁdera parakāśa |
manaḥkathā nṛsiṃhānanda, siddha kaila gauracandra,
guṇa gāẏa e locanadāsa || 24 ||

shuna shuna sarvajana — hear, all people; savadhane diya mana — attentively, setting your minds; shri-gorachandera parakasha — the manifestation of Sri Gorachand; manah-katha nrisimhananda — Nrisimhananda's wish of the mind; siddha kaila gaurachandra — Gaurachandra fulfilled; guna gaya e lochanadasa — this Lochana Dasa sings the glories

24Hear, all people, attentively, setting your minds on it,
of the manifestation of Sri Gorachand:
the wish of Nrisimhananda's mind Gaurachandra fulfilled —
of His glories this Lochana Dasa sings14.

Raga shri; disha: "Gorachand — oh! — plays in Nilachala"

তবে নীলাচলে প্রভু ভক্তগণ-সঙ্গে ।
কীর্তন-বিলাস করে আছে নানা-রঙ্গে ॥ ২৫ ॥

tabe nīlācale prabhu bhaktagaṇa-saṅge |
kīrtana-bilāsa kare āche nānā-raṅge || 25 ||

tabe nilachale — and so in Nilachala; prabhu bhaktagana-sange — the Lord with the devotees; kirtana-vilasa kare — delights in kirtana; achhe nana-range — stays in various sports

25And so in Nilachala the Lord with the devotees
delights in kirtana and stays in various sports.

অনেক ভকতগণ মিলিলা তথায় ।
প্রেম বিলসয়ে প্রভু নাচয়ে নাচায় ॥ ২৬ ॥

aneka bhakatagaṇa mililā tathāẏa |
prema bilasaẏe prabhu nācaẏe nācāẏa || 26 ||

aneka bhakatagana — many devotees; milila tathaya — gathered there; prema vilasaye prabhu — the Lord enjoys prema; nachaye nachaya — dances and makes others dance

26Many devotees gathered there;
the Lord enjoys prema — He dances and makes others dance.

নানাদেশে আছিল যতেক ভক্তগণে ।
ক্রমে ক্রমে মিলিলেন চৈতন্য-চরণে ॥ ২৭ ॥

nānādeśe āchila yateka bhaktagaṇe |
krame krame mililena caitanya-caraṇe || 27 ||

nanadeshe achhila — lived in various lands; yateka bhaktagane — all the devotees; krame krame — little by little; mililena chaitanya-charane — came to the feet of Chaitanya

27All the devotees who lived in various lands
little by little came to the feet of Chaitanya.

আনন্দে আছয়ে প্রভু নীলাচল-বাসে ।
কহিব সকল পাছু অনেক প্রকাশে ॥ ২৮ ॥

ānande āchaẏe prabhu nīlācala-bāse |
kahiba sakala pāchu aneka prakāśe || 28 ||

anande achhaye prabhu — the Lord stays in bliss; nilachala-vase — dwelling in Nilachala; kahiba sakala pachhu — I will tell everything later; aneka prakashe — in detail

28In bliss the Lord dwells in Nilachala;
of all this I shall tell later in detail.

মথুরা চলিব মনঃকথা আচম্বিত ।
উৎকণ্ঠা বাঢ়িল হিয়া উনমত-চিত ॥ ২৯ ॥

mathurā caliba manaḥkathā ācambita |
utkaṇṭhā bāṛhila hiẏā unamata-cita || 29 ||

mathura chaliba — "I will go to Mathura"; manah-katha achambita — suddenly a wish in the mind; utkantha badhila hiya — longing grew in the heart; unamata-chita — the mind maddened

29Suddenly [the Lord] has a wish in His mind: "I will go to Mathura";
longing grew in His heart, His mind as though maddened.

চলিলা মথুরা-পথে চৈতন্য ঠাকুর ।
পথে যাইতে প্রেমানন্দ বাঢ়িল প্রচুর ॥ ৩০ ॥

calilā mathurā-pathe caitanya ṭhākura |
pathe yāite premānanda bāṛhila pracura || 30 ||

chalila mathura-pathe — set out on the road to Mathura; chaitanya thakura — Chaitanya Thakura; pathe yaite — on the way; premananda badhila prachura — the bliss of prema grew greatly

30Chaitanya Thakura set out on the road to Mathura;
on the way the bliss of prema grew beyond measure.

অনুরাগে ধায় প্রভু রাঙ্গা দুই আঁখি ।
সিংহের গমনে ধায় দেখিতে না দেখি ॥ ৩১ ॥

anurāge dhāẏa prabhu rāṅgā dui āṁkhi |
siṃhera gamane dhāẏa dekhite nā dekhi || 31 ||

anurage dhaya prabhu — the Lord runs in loving longing; ranga dui ankhi — both eyes red; simhera gamane dhaya — runs with a lion's gait; dekhite na dekhi — no sooner seen than gone

31In loving longing the Lord runs, both eyes red;
He runs with a lion's gait — no sooner seen than gone.

সঙ্গের সঙ্গতিগণ না পারে হাঁটিতে ।
কথোদূরে যায় প্রভু ডাকিতে ডাকিতে ॥ ৩২ ॥

saṅgera saṅgatigaṇa nā pāre hāṁṭite |
kathodūre yāẏa prabhu ḍākite ḍākite || 32 ||

sangera sangatigana — the companions with Him; na pare hantite — cannot keep pace; kathodure yaya prabhu — the Lord goes far ahead; dakite dakite — calling and calling

32The companions who were with Him cannot keep up;
the Lord goes far ahead, calling [for Krishna].

ঝারিখণ্ড-পথে প্রভু চলিলা সত্বর ।
কান্দাইলা পশু পক্ষী বৃক্ষাদি প্রস্তর ॥ ৩৩ ॥

jhārikhaṇḍa-pathe prabhu calilā satbara |
kāndāilā paśu pakṣī bṛkṣādi prastara || 33 ||

jharikhanda-pathe — by the Jharikhanda road; prabhu chalila satvara — the Lord went in haste; kandaila — made weep; pashu pakshi vrikshadi prastara — beasts, birds, trees and stones

33By the road through Jharikhanda the Lord went in haste;
He made beasts, birds, trees, even stones weep.

গৌরাঙ্গ বেড়িয়া মৃগ-ব্যাঘ্রগণ নাচে ।
হিংসা নাহি সবে সুখে নাচে প্রভু-কাছে ॥ ৩৪ ॥

gaurāṅga beṛiẏā mṛga-byāghragaṇa nāce |
hiṃsā nāhi sabe sukhe nāce prabhu-kāche || 34 ||

gauranga bediya — surrounding Gauranga; mriga-vyaghragana nache — deer and tigers dance; himsa nahi — there is no violence; sabe sukhe nache — all dance joyfully; prabhu-kachhe — near the Lord

34Surrounding Gauranga, deer and tigers dance;
there is no violence [in them] — all dance joyfully near the Lord.

বনজন্তুগণ সব কৃতার্থ করিয়া ।
চলিলা গৌরাঙ্গ পথে প্রেম-বিনোদিয়া ॥ ৩৫ ॥

banajantugaṇa saba kṛtārtha kariẏā |
calilā gaurāṅga pathe prema-binodiẏā || 35 ||

vanajantugana saba — all the forest animals; kritartha kariya — having blessed; chalila gauranga pathe — Gauranga went on His way; prema-vinodiya — delighting in prema

35Having blessed all the forest animals,
Gauranga went on His way, delighting in prema15.

ক্রমে ক্রমে উত্তরিলা তীর্থ বারাণসী ।
অনেক আছয়ে তথা পরম সন্ন্যাসী ॥ ৩৬ ॥

krame krame uttarilā tīrtha bārāṇasī |
aneka āchaẏe tathā parama sannyāsī || 36 ||

krame krame — little by little; uttarila tirtha varanasi — reached holy Varanasi; aneka achhaye tatha — there live many; parama sannyasi — great sannyasis

36Little by little He came to holy Varanasi;
many great sannyasis live there.

বিশ্বেশ্বর নমস্করি' চলি' যায় পথে ।
প্রয়াগে মাধব দেখি' হরষিত চিতে ॥ ৩৭ ॥

biśbeśbara namaskari' cali' yāẏa pathe |
praẏāge mādhaba dekhi' haraṣita cite || 37 ||

vishveshvara namaskari — bowing to Vishveshvara; chali yaya pathe — goes along the road; prayage madhava dekhi — at Prayaga seeing Madhava; harashita chite — glad at heart

37Bowing to Vishveshvara, He goes on along the road;
at Prayaga, seeing Madhava, He rejoiced at heart.

রূপ-সনাতন গোসাঞি প্রভুরে মিলিলা ।
অনুগ্রহ করি' তারে শক্তি সঞ্চারিলা ॥ ৩৮ ॥

rūpa-sanātana gosāñi prabhure mililā |
anugraha kari' tāre śakti sañcārilā || 38 ||

rupa-sanatana gosani — Rupa and Sanatana Gosani; prabhure milila — met the Lord; anugraha kari — showing grace; tare shakti sancharila — imparted power to them

38Rupa and Sanatana Gosani met the Lord;
showing them grace, He imparted His power to them16.

তথা বেণী-স্নান করি' দেখি' অক্ষয়বট ।
যমুনাতে পার হৈলা আগরা নিকট ॥ ৩৯ ॥

tathā beṇī-snāna kari' dekhi' akṣaẏabaṭa |
yamunāte pāra hailā āgarā nikaṭa || 39 ||

tatha veni-snana kari — there, bathing at the Veni; dekhi akshayavata — seeing the Akshaya-vata; yamunate para haila — crossed the Yamuna; agara nikata — near Agra

39There, bathing at the Veni and seeing the Akshaya-vata,
He crossed the Yamuna near Agra.

দেখিলা অদ্ভুত সে রেণুকা নামে গ্রাম ।
অবতার কৈলা যেই স্থানে পরশুরাম ॥ ৪০ ॥

dekhilā adbhuta se reṇukā nāme grāma |
abatāra kailā yei sthāne paraśurāma || 40 ||

dekhila adbhuta — He saw a wondrous; se renuka name grama — village named Renuka; avatara kaila — appeared; yei sthane parashurama — the place where Parashurama

40He saw a wondrous village named Renuka —
the place where Parashurama appeared.

তথা বৃন্দাবন-মুখে যমুনা বিমুখী ।
দেখিয়া বিহ্বল প্রভু প্রেমসুখে সুখী ॥ ৪১ ॥

tathā bṛndābana-mukhe yamunā bimukhī |
dekhiẏā bihbala prabhu premasukhe sukhī || 41 ||

tatha — there; vrindavana-mukhe — facing Vrindavana; yamuna vimukhi — the Yamuna, turned [back]; dekhiya — seeing; vihvala prabhu — the Lord beside Himself; prema-sukhe sukhi — happy with the happiness of prema

41There the Yamuna, turning [back], faces Vrindavana;
seeing this, the Lord, beside Himself, is happy with the happiness of prema17.

রাজগ্রামে গিয়া পারে দেখয়ে গোকুল ।
সম্বরিতে নারে হিয়া ভৈ গেল আকুল ॥ ৪২ ॥

rājagrāme giẏā pāre dekhaẏe gokula |
sambarite nāre hiẏā bhai gela ākula || 42 ||

rajagrame giya — coming to Rajagrama; pare dekhaye gokula — sees Gokula on the far bank; sambarite nare hiya — cannot restrain His heart; bhai gela akula — became distraught

42Coming to Rajagrama, He sees Gokula on the far bank;
unable to restrain His heart, He became distraught.

হিয়া সম্বরিল প্রভু অনেক যতনে ।
আনন্দে বিহ্বল পারে দেখে মহাবনে ॥ ৪৩ ॥

hiẏā sambarila prabhu aneka yatane |
ānande bihbala pāre dekhe mahābane || 43 ||

hiya sambarila prabhu — the Lord restrained His heart; aneka yatane — with great effort; anande vihvala — overwhelmed with bliss; pare dekhe mahavane — sees Mahavana on the far bank

43With great effort the Lord restrained His heart;
overwhelmed with bliss, He sees Mahavana on the far bank.

যাইতে যাইতে আর গিয়া কথোদূর ।
সুনিকট হৈল যেই দেখে মধুপুর ॥ ৪৪ ॥

yāite yāite āra giẏā kathodūra |
sunikaṭa haila yei dekhe madhupura || 44 ||

yaite yaite — going and going; ara giya kathodura — going some distance more; sunikata haila — He drew near; yei dekhe madhupura — and sees Madhupura

44He went on and on some distance more —
and, drawing near, He sees Madhupura.

মধুপুর দেখি' প্রভু উনমত-চিত ।
প্রেমায় বিহ্বল যেন নাহিক সম্বিত ॥ ৪৫ ॥

madhupura dekhi' prabhu unamata-cita |
premāẏa bihbala yena nāhika sambita || 45 ||

madhupura dekhi — seeing Madhupura; prabhu unamata-chita — the Lord mad at heart; premaya vihvala — overcome with prema; yena nahika samvita — as if without consciousness

45Seeing Madhupura, the Lord became mad at heart;
overcome with prema, He seemed to lose consciousness.

অক্রূর অক্রূর বলি' ভূমিতে পড়িলা ।
মাথুর-বিরহ-ভাবে মূর্ছিত হইলা ॥ ৪৬ ॥

akrūra akrūra bali' bhūmite paṛilā |
māthura-biraha-bhābe mūrchita hailā || 46 ||

akrura akrura bali — crying "Akrura! Akrura!"; bhumite padila — fell to the ground; mathura-viraha-bhave — in the bhava of separation [when Krishna left for] Mathura; murchhita haila — fainted

46Crying "Akrura! Akrura!", He fell to the ground;
in the bhava of separation, [when Krishna left for] Mathura, He fainted18.

দিবানিশি নাহি জানে আছে সেইখানে ।
সম্বেদন নাহি প্রভুর ভেল তিন দিনে ॥ ৪৭ ॥

dibāniśi nāhi jāne āche seikhāne |
sambedana nāhi prabhura bhela tina dine || 47 ||

divanishi nahi jane — knows not day or night; achhe seikhane — remains there; sambedana nahi prabhura — the Lord had no consciousness; bhela tina dine — for three days

47Not knowing day or night, He remains in that place;
for three days the Lord was without consciousness.

গতাগতি করে লোক দেখয়ে আশ্চর্য ।
কৃষ্ণদাস নামে এক আছে দ্বিজবর্য ॥ ৪৮ ॥

gatāgati kare loka dekhaẏe āścarya |
kṛṣṇadāsa nāme eka āche dbijabarya || 48 ||

gatagati kare loka — people come and go; dekhaye ashcharya — see the marvel; krishnadasa name eka — one named Krishnadasa; achhe dvijavarya — there is, a foremost brahmana

48People come and go and look at this marvel.
There lived [there] a foremost brahmana named Krishnadasa.

প্রভুরে দেখিয়া সেই গণে মনে মনে ।
কোথা হৈতে আইল এই পুরুষরতনে ॥ ৪৯ ॥

prabhure dekhiẏā sei gaṇe mane mane |
kothā haite āila ei puruṣaratane || 49 ||

prabhure dekhiya — seeing the Lord; sei gane mane mane — he reflects within himself; kotha haite aila — from where has come; ei purusha-ratane — this jewel among men

49Seeing the Lord, he thinks within himself:
"From where has this jewel among men come?

বড় ভাগ্যে দেখিলাম ইহার চরণ ।
এই শুক প্রহ্লাদ কিবা হেন লয় মন ॥ ৫০ ॥

baṛa bhāgye dekhilāma ihāra caraṇa |
ei śuka prahlāda kibā hena laẏa mana || 50 ||

bada bhagye — by great fortune; dekhilama ihara charana — I have seen His feet; ei shuka prahlada kiba — is this Shuka or Prahlada; hena laya mana — so my mind takes it

50By great fortune I have seen His feet;
is this Shuka or Prahlada? — so my mind takes it."

প্রেমায় বিহ্বল প্রভু পুছিল তাহারে ।
কি নাম তোমার কহ শুন দ্বিজবরে ॥ ৫১ ॥

premāẏa bihbala prabhu puchila tāhāre |
ki nāma tomāra kaha śuna dbijabare || 51 ||

premaya vihvala prabhu — the Lord, overcome with prema; puchhila tahare — asked him; ki nama tomara kaha — tell, what is your name; shuna dvijavare — listen, best of brahmanas

51The Lord, overcome with prema, asked him:
"What is your name? Tell Me — listen, best of brahmanas."

ব্রাহ্মণ কহয়ে শুন শুন ন্যাসিবর ।
কৃষ্ণদাস নাম মোর করিল উত্তর ॥ ৫২ ॥

brāhmaṇa kahaẏe śuna śuna nyāsibara |
kṛṣṇadāsa nāma mora karila uttara || 52 ||

brahmana kahaye — the brahmana says; shuna shuna nyasivara — listen, listen, best of sannyasis; krishnadasa nama mora — my name is Krishnadasa; karila uttara — he answered

52The brahmana says: "Listen, listen, best of sannyasis:
my name is Krishnadasa" — so he answered.

এ বোল শুনিঞা প্রভু অট্ট অট্ট হাস ।
কৃষ্ণের সকলি জান তুমি কৃষ্ণদাস ॥ ৫৩ ॥

e bola śuniñā prabhu aṭṭa aṭṭa hāsa |
kṛṣṇera sakali jāna tumi kṛṣṇadāsa || 53 ||

e bola shuninya — hearing this; prabhu atta atta hasa — the Lord laughed aloud; krishnera sakali jana — you know everything of Krishna; tumi krishnadasa — you, Krishnadasa

53Hearing this, the Lord laughed aloud:
"You, Krishnadasa, know everything of Krishna.

জুড়াইল দেহ মোর তোমার সম্ভাষে ।
তুমি দেখাইবে যথা যে আছে বিশেষে ॥ ৫৪ ॥

juṛāila deha mora tomāra sambhāṣe |
tumi dekhāibe yathā ye āche biśeṣe || 54 ||

judaila deha mora — refreshed My body; tomara sambhashe — your words; tumi dekhaibe — you will show; yatha ye achhe visheshe — what is where, in detail

54Your words have refreshed My body;
you will show Me all that is anywhere, in every detail.

মথুরামণ্ডল এই কৃষ্ণের অন্তরীণ ।
সকল জানহ তুমি ভকত প্রবীণ ॥ ৫৫ ॥

mathurāmaṇḍala ei kṛṣṇera antarīṇa |
sakala jānaha tumi bhakata prabīṇa || 55 ||

mathura-mandala ei — this Mathura-mandala; krishnera antarina — Krishna's inner [abode]; sakala janaha tumi — you know everything; bhakata pravina — an experienced devotee

55This Mathura-mandala is Krishna's inner abode;
you, an experienced devotee, know everything.

যেখানে যে কৈল কৃষ্ণ সব তুমি জান ।
মথুরামণ্ডল মোরে দেখাও স্থানে স্থান ॥ ৫৬ ॥

yekhāne ye kaila kṛṣṇa saba tumi jāna |
mathurāmaṇḍala more dekhāo sthāne sthāna || 56 ||

yekhane ye kaila krishna — what Krishna did where; saba tumi jana — you know it all; mathura-mandala more dekhao — show Me the Mathura-mandala; sthane sthana — place by place

56You know what Krishna did and where —
show Me the Mathura-mandala, place by place."

দ্বিজ কহে সব স্থান না জানিয়ে আমি ।
দ্বাদশ বনের স্থান সবে আমি জানি ॥ ৫৭ ॥

dbija kahe saba sthāna nā jāniẏe āmi |
dbādaśa banera sthāna sabe āmi jāni || 57 ||

dvija kahe — the brahmana says; saba sthana na janiye ami — I do not know all the places; dvadasha vanera sthana — the places of the twelve forests; sabe ami jani — only these I know

57The brahmana says: "I do not know all the places;
I know only the places of the twelve forests."

এ বোল শুনিঞা প্রভু প্রেমানন্দে হাসে ।
তাহার শরীরে শক্তি করিলা প্রকাশে ॥ ৫৮ ॥

e bola śuniñā prabhu premānande hāse |
tāhāra śarīre śakti karilā prakāśe || 58 ||

e bola shuninya — hearing this; prabhu premanande hase — the Lord laughs in the bliss of prema; tahara sharire — in his body; shakti karila prakashe — manifested power

58Hearing this, the Lord laughs in the bliss of prema
and manifested [His] power in his body.

মহানন্দে বোলে আমি সব দেখাইব ।
কৃষ্ণজন্ম হৈতে কংসবধ শুনাইব ॥ ৫৯ ॥

mahānande bole āmi saba dekhāiba |
kṛṣṇajanma haite kaṃsabadha śunāiba || 59 ||

maha-anande bole — says in great bliss; ami saba dekhaiba — I will show everything; krishna-janma haite — from Krishna's birth; kamsa-vadha shunaiba — to the slaying of Kamsa I will tell

59In great bliss [the brahmana] says: "I will show everything;
from Krishna's birth to the slaying of Kamsa — I will tell it all."

দ্বিজ কহে শুন শুন শুন মহাশয় ।
নন্দের নন্দন তুমি জানিল নিশ্চয় ॥ ৬০ ॥

dbija kahe śuna śuna śuna mahāśaẏa |
nandera nandana tumi jānila niścaẏa || 60 ||

dvija kahe — the brahmana says; shuna shuna shuna mahashaya — listen, listen, listen, sir; nandera nandana tumi — You are the son of Nanda; janila nishchaya — I know for certain

60The brahmana says: "Listen, listen, listen, sir:
I know for certain — You are the son of Nanda.

তোমার দর্শনে মোর ব্রজ-দরশন ।
আচম্বিতে সব মোর হৈল সঙরণ ॥ ৬১ ॥

tomāra darśane mora braja-daraśana |
ācambite saba mora haila saṅaraṇa || 61 ||

tomara darshane — by seeing You; mora vraja-darashana — I have seen Vraja; achambite — suddenly; saba mora haila sanarana — everything came back to my memory

61Seeing You, I have seen Vraja:
suddenly everything came back to my memory.

যেখানে যে জানি আমি স্থানের মরম ।
যেখানে যে ভগবান্ জনম-করম ॥ ৬২ ॥

yekhāne ye jāni āmi sthānera marama |
yekhāne ye bhagabān janama-karama || 62 ||

yekhane ye jani ami — whatever I know of where; sthanera marama — the inner meaning of the place; yekhane ye — where and what; bhagavan janama-karama — Bhagavan's birth and deeds

62I [will reveal] the inner meaning of every place I know —
where Bhagavan was born and what He did."

এ বোল শুনিয়া প্রভু হরিষ হিয়ায় ।
কৃষ্ণদাসে কোলে করি' কৃষ্ণ-গুণ গায় ॥ ৬৩ ॥

e bola śuniẏā prabhu hariṣa hiẏāẏa |
kṛṣṇadāse kole kari' kṛṣṇa-guṇa gāẏa || 63 ||

e bola shuniya — hearing this; prabhu harisha hiyaya — the Lord, glad at heart; krishnadase kole kari — embracing Krishnadasa; krishna-guna gaya — sings the glories of Krishna

63Hearing this, the Lord, with joy in His heart,
embraced Krishnadasa and sings the glories of Krishna19.

সেদিন বঞ্চিলা কৃষ্ণদাসের আলয় ।
মথুরামণ্ডল-কথা সর্বরাত্র কয় ॥ ৬৪ ॥

sedina bañcilā kṛṣṇadāsera ālaẏa |
mathurāmaṇḍala-kathā sarbarātra kaẏa || 64 ||

sedina vanchila — that day He spent; krishnadasera alaya — in Krishnadasa's house; mathura-mandala-katha — the account of the Mathura-mandala; sarvaratra kaya — he tells all night

64That day He spent in Krishnadasa's house;
all night [Krishnadasa] tells of the Mathura-mandala:

মথুরামণ্ডল-মধ্যে যমুনা ভাগ্যবতী ।
যাহার দুকূলে কৃষ্ণ বিহরে পীরিতি ॥ ৬৫ ॥

mathurāmaṇḍala-madhye yamunā bhāgyabatī |
yāhāra dukūle kṛṣṇa bihare pīriti || 65 ||

mathura-mandala-madhye — in the midst of the Mathura-mandala; yamuna bhagyavati — the blessed Yamuna; yahara dukule — on both banks of which; krishna vihare piriti — Krishna sports in love

65"In the midst of the Mathura-mandala is the blessed Yamuna,
on both banks of which Krishna sports in love.

যমুনার পূর্বকূলে আছে পাঁচ বন ।
পশ্চিমেতে সাত বন কহিব এখন ॥ ৬৬ ॥

yamunāra pūrbakūle āche pāṁca bana |
paścimete sāta bana kahiba ekhana || 66 ||

yamunara purvakule — on the eastern bank of the Yamuna; achhe pancha vana — there are five forests; pashchimete sata vana — on the western seven forests; kahiba ekhana — I will tell now

66On the eastern bank of the Yamuna there are five forests,
on the western seven forests; now I shall tell of them.

কৃষ্ণের বিহার এই দ্বাদশ বনে ।
ভক্ত বিনে কেহো ইহার মরম না জানে ॥ ৬৭ ॥

kṛṣṇera bihāra ei dbādaśa bane |
bhakta bine keho ihāra marama nā jāne || 67 ||

krishnera vihara — Krishna's pastimes; ei dvadasha vane — in these twelve forests; bhakta vine — apart from devotees; keho ihara marama na jane — no one knows their secret

67In these twelve forests are Krishna's pastimes;
apart from devotees no one knows their secret.

কংসের সদন এই যমুনা-পশ্চিমে ।
তাহার উত্তরে বন বৃন্দাবন নামে ॥ ৬৮ ॥

kaṃsera sadana ei yamunā-paścime |
tāhāra uttare bana bṛndābana nāme || 68 ||

kamsera sadana ei — here is Kamsa's palace; yamuna-pashchime — west of the Yamuna; tahara uttare — to the north of it; vana vrindavana name — the forest named Vrindavana

68Here is Kamsa's palace — west of the Yamuna;
to the north of it is the forest named Vrindavana.

মথুরা হইতে সেই যোজনেক পথ ।
অনেক রহস্য কথা কহিব তাহাত ॥ ৬৯ ॥

mathurā haite sei yojaneka patha |
aneka rahasya kathā kahiba tāhāta || 69 ||

mathura haite — from Mathura; sei yojaneka patha — it is a yojana's journey; aneka rahasya katha — many secret things; kahiba tahata — I will tell about it

69From Mathura to it is one yojana of road;
of it I shall tell many secret things.

কুমুদ নামে বন আছে তাহার নৈঋতে ।
সওয়া যোজন পথ মথুরা হইতে ॥ ৭০ ॥

kumuda nāme bana āche tāhāra naiṛte |
saoẏā yojana patha mathurā haite || 70 ||

kumuda name vana — the forest named Kumuda; achhe tahara nairite — lies south-west of it; saoya yojana patha — a yojana and a quarter's journey; mathura haite — from Mathura

70To the south-west of it is a forest named Kumuda,
one and a quarter yojanas' journey from Mathura.

খদিরবন আছে প্রভু তাহার দক্ষিণে ।
দেড় যোজন পথ মথুরার সনে ॥ ৭১ ॥

khadirabana āche prabhu tāhāra dakṣiṇe |
deṛa yojana patha mathurāra sane || 71 ||

khadira-vana achhe prabhu — there is, Lord, the Khadira-vana; tahara dakshine — south of it; deda yojana patha — a yojana and a half's journey; mathurara sane — from Mathura

71South of it, Lord, is the Khadira-vana,
a yojana and a half's journey from Mathura.

তালবন আছে প্রভু দক্ষিণে মথুরার ।
অর্ধ যোজন ভূমি মথুরা তাহার ॥ ৭২ ॥

tālabana āche prabhu dakṣiṇe mathurāra |
ardha yojana bhūmi mathurā tāhāra || 72 ||

talavana achhe prabhu — there is, Lord, the Talavana; dakshine mathurara — south of Mathura; ardha yojana bhumi — half a yojana of land; mathura tahara — from Mathura to it

72The Tala-vana, Lord, is south of Mathura:
from Mathura it is half a yojana away.

এক নদী-ধারা আছে মানসগঙ্গা নামে ।
বৃন্দাবন-পশ্চিমে সে মথুরা-ঈশানে ॥ ৭৩ ॥

eka nadī-dhārā āche mānasagaṅgā nāme |
bṛndābana-paścime se mathurā-īśāne || 73 ||

eka nadi-dhara achhe — there is a stream; manasaganga name — named Manasa-Ganga; vrindavana-pashchime se — west of Vrindavana; mathura-ishane — north-east of Mathura

73There is a stream — a river named Manasa-Ganga:
west of Vrindavana, north-east of Mathura.

কাম্যকবন হৈতে মধুবনের উদ্দেশ ।
কালীদহ-পশ্চিমে যমুনা পরবেশ ॥ ৭৪ ॥

kāmyakabana haite madhubanera uddeśa |
kālīdaha-paścime yamunā parabeśa || 74 ||

kamyaka-vana haite — from the Kamyaka-vana; madhuvanera uddesha — towards Madhuvana; kalidaha-pashchime — west of the Kaliya-daha; yamuna paravesha — entry into the Yamuna

74From the Kamyaka-vana [it flows] towards Madhuvana
and west of the Kaliya-daha enters the Yamuna.

সরস্বতী নামে এক ধারা আছে তাথে ।
মথুরার উত্তরে সে প্রবেশে যমুনাতে ॥ ৭৫ ॥

sarasbatī nāme eka dhārā āche tāthe |
mathurāra uttare se prabeśe yamunāte || 75 ||

sarasvati name eka dhara — a stream named Sarasvati; achhe tathe — is there; mathurara uttare — north of Mathura; se praveshe yamunate — it enters the Yamuna

75There is also a stream named Sarasvati there:
north of Mathura it enters the Yamuna.

মথুরা-পশ্চিমে আছে গোবর্ধন-গিরি ।
আউট যোজন সে মথুরা হইতে ধরি' ॥ ৭৬ ॥

mathurā-paścime āche gobardhana-giri |
āuṭa yojana se mathurā haite dhari' || 76 ||

mathura-pashchime — west of Mathura; achhe govardhana-giri — is the hill of Govardhana; auta yojana — three and a half yojanas; se mathura haite dhari — reckoning from Mathura

76West of Mathura is the hill of Govardhana,
three and a half yojanas, counting from Mathura.

কহিব কাম্যকবন গোবর্ধন-পশ্চিমে ।
মথুরা হইতে আউট যোজন লোকে গণে ॥ ৭৭ ॥

kahiba kāmyakabana gobardhana-paścime |
mathurā haite āuṭa yojana loke gaṇe || 77 ||

kahiba kamyaka-vana — I will tell of the Kamyaka-vana; govardhana-pashchime — west of Govardhana; mathura haite — from Mathura; auta yojana loke gane — three and a half yojanas, as people reckon

77I shall tell of the Kamyaka-vana — west of Govardhana:
from Mathura, as people reckon, three and a half yojanas.

বহুলা নামে বন আছে মথুরা-ঈশানে ।
মানসগঙ্গার পার সে দুই যোজনে ॥ ৭৮ ॥

bahulā nāme bana āche mathurā-īśāne |
mānasagaṅgāra pāra se dui yojane || 78 ||

bahula name vana — the forest named Bahula; achhe mathura-ishane — north-east of Mathura; manasagangara para — beyond the Manasa-Ganga; se dui yojane — at two yojanas

78The forest named Bahula is north-east of Mathura,
beyond the Manasa-Ganga, at two yojanas.

এই সাত বন সে পশ্চিমে যমুনার ।
কহিব ত পূর্বকূলে পাঁচ বন আর ॥ ৭৯ ॥

ei sāta bana se paścime yamunāra |
kahiba ta pūrbakūle pāṁca bana āra || 79 ||

ei sata vana — these seven forests; se pashchime yamunara — are west of the Yamuna; kahiba ta — I will tell now; purvakule pancha vana ara — of the five other forests on the eastern bank

79These are the seven forests west of the Yamuna;
now I shall tell of the five forests on the eastern bank.

মহাবন নামে বন যমুনা-নিকটে ।
মথুরা হইতে সেই যোজনেক বাটে ॥ ৮০ ॥

mahābana nāme bana yamunā-nikaṭe |
mathurā haite sei yojaneka bāṭe || 80 ||

mahavana name vana — the forest named Mahavana; yamuna-nikate — near the Yamuna; mathura haite — from Mathura; sei yojaneka bate — a yojana's way

80The forest named Mahavana is near the Yamuna,
one yojana's journey from Mathura.

বিল্ব নামে বন আছে পশ্চিমে তাহার ।
অর্ধ যোজন সে মথুরা হইতে পার ॥ ৮১ ॥

bilba nāme bana āche paścime tāhāra |
ardha yojana se mathurā haite pāra || 81 ||

bilva name vana — the forest named Bilva; achhe pashchime tahara — is west of it; ardha yojana — half a yojana; se mathura haite para — across from Mathura

81To the west of it is the forest named Bilva,
half a yojana from Mathura, on the far bank.

তাহার উত্তরে আছে লোহ নামে বন ।
ভাণ্ডীর নামে বন আছে তাহার ঈশান ॥ ৮২ ॥

tāhāra uttare āche loha nāme bana |
bhāṇḍīra nāme bana āche tāhāra īśāna || 82 ||

tahara uttare — north of it; achhe loha name vana — is the forest named Loha; bhandira name vana — the forest named Bhandira; achhe tahara ishana — is north-east of it

82To the north of it is the forest named Loha;
to the north-east of it is the forest named Bhandira.

একত্রই দুই বন যমুনার কূলে ।
মহাবন হৈতে লোকে আউট যোজন বোলে ॥ ৮৩ ॥

ekatrai dui bana yamunāra kūle |
mahābana haite loke āuṭa yojana bole || 83 ||

ekatrai dui vana — these two forests together; yamunara kule — on the bank of the Yamuna; mahavana haite — from Mahavana; loke auta yojana bole — people say three and a half yojanas

83These two forests lie together on the bank of the Yamuna;
from Mahavana, people say, three and a half yojanas.

এই দ্বাদশ বন মথুরামণ্ডল ।
কৃষ্ণের বিহার-স্থান দেখাব সকল ॥ ৮৪ ॥

ei dbādaśa bana mathurāmaṇḍala |
kṛṣṇera bihāra-sthāna dekhāba sakala || 84 ||

ei dvadasha vana — these twelve forests; mathura-mandala — the Mathura-mandala; krishnera vihara-sthana — the places of Krishna's pastimes; dekhaba sakala — I will show them all

84These are the twelve forests — the Mathura-mandala;
all the places of Krishna's pastimes I will show [You]"20.

✦

Notes

  1. Panchavati is the forest on the Godavari (near present-day Nasik) where Rama, Sita and Lakshmana lived in exile; cf. Murari 3.15.6.
  2. The Lord, in the mood of Rama, lives through the abduction of Sita as though it were happening now. Cf. Murari 3.16.3–4 (on the way to Setubandha).
  3. Shrirangam on the Kaveri; cf. Murari 3.15.7–17. In the Chaitanya-charitamrita (Madhya 9) the Lord spends the chaturmasya in the house of Venkata Bhatta, Trimalla's brother.
  4. Vv. 132+1 — 132+5 are found only in the 1983 edition; the 1903 edition gives them only in a footnote, as an additional reading of a printed edition. The chaturmasya is the four months of the rains (Ashadha to Ashvina), when sannyasis do not travel.
  5. Vv. 134–144 — cf. Murari 3.15.19–25. In the Chaitanya-charitamrita (Madhya 9) the Lord meets Paramananda Puri at the Rishabha hill after Shrirangam.
  6. In the 1983 edition the verse is cited as from the Vayu Purana (in A the heading of the quotation is corrupted by the OCR); the 1903 edition gives it only in a footnote, as an additional reading of a printed edition. Bhaktisiddhanta's prose rendering of the verse is not translated. "The first twilight of Kali" is the opening period of the Kali-yuga; on the Daru-brahman (Jagannatha) see en/45, note 15. Vv. 138–141 are Madhavendra Puri's words, a Bengali paraphrase of this verse.
  7. Vv. 142+1 — 142+4 are found only in the 1983 edition; the 1903 edition gives them only in a footnote, as an additional reading of one manuscript. Madhavendra Puri is the guru of Ishvara Puri, and so the Lord's "grandfather" in the line of gurus.
  8. The summary in A is badly corrupted by the OCR in places; gaps are filled from the sense and from Bhaktisiddhanta's table of contents (chapter 2 of the Shesha-khanda). In the 1983 edition chapter 2 ("The Lord Sees Vrindavana") begins later — at v. 18 (the song of Nrisimhananda); vv. 1–17 there close chapter 1.
  9. Vv. 4+1 — 4+2 are found only in the 1983 edition; the 1903 edition gives them only in a footnote, as an additional reading of a printed edition. Cf. Murari 3.16.1–2 (in Murari, tamala trees). According to the Chaitanya-charitamrita (Madhya 9), the Lord embraced the seven palms and sent them to Vaikuntha; these are the seven palms that Rama pierced with one arrow to convince Sugriva of His strength.
  10. Cf. Murari 3.16.3–6. The Lord, in the mood of Rama, calls His associates — Lakshmana, Angada, Hanuman, Sugriva, Vibhishana. Rameshvara is the linga of Shiva installed, by tradition, by Rama Himself; for Vaishnavas Shiva is the greatest of devotees.
  11. A second chaturmasya (on the Godavari) is peculiar to Lochana Dasa's account; according to the Chaitanya-charitamrita (Madhya 9), in the South the Lord spent one chaturmasya — at Shrirangam — and on the way back only met Ramananda again on the Godavari (cf. Murari 3.16.9–11).
  12. Alalanatha is Vishnu at Brahmagiri, south of Puri. Vishnudasa is in Murari (3.16.12) the brahmana with whom the Lord sees Alalanatha.
  13. "Attained Vaikuntha" — left this world. Nrisimhananda (Pradyumna Brahmachari) in Murari (3.17.5–8) and in the Chaitanya-charitamrita (Madhya 1) paves in his mind a road for the Lord from Bengal (from Kuliya) to Vrindavana, but cannot take it beyond Kanai's Natashala and therefore foretells that the Lord will turn back from there; in those accounts he does not die and himself tells the devotees about it. Kanai's Natashala is a village on the Ganga near Rajmahal, where the Lord, on His first attempt to go to Vrindavana, turned back.
  14. In Lochana Dasa the Lord turns back from Kanai's Natashala even before the journey to Mathura told next; of His route through Bengal (Ramakeli, Kuliya) Lochana Dasa says nothing here.
  15. Cf. the Chaitanya-charitamrita (Madhya 17): going through the forests of Jharikhanda, the Lord makes tigers and deer dance together and chant the name of Krishna. In Murari (4.01) the Lord goes from Puri through Kashi.
  16. Vv. 36–38 — cf. Murari 4.01–4.02.1. According to the Chaitanya-charitamrita (Madhya 19–20), the Lord meets Rupa at Prayaga and Sanatana at Kashi, on the way back from Vrindavana; Lochana Dasa places the meeting with both on the way to Mathura. "Imparted His power" (shakti-sanchara) — empowered them to reveal to the world the teaching and the lilas of Vraja.
  17. Vv. 39–45 — cf. Murari 4.02.2–6. The Akshaya-vata is the "imperishable banyan" at Prayaga; the Veni (Triveni) is the confluence of the Ganga, Yamuna and Sarasvati. V. 41 we understand as in Murari (4.02.5): the Yamuna "ever turned towards the forest of Vrinda."
  18. Akrura took Krishna away from Vraja to Mathura, and the gopis in separation blamed him. Seeing Mathura, the Lord lives through the separation of the gopis (of Radha) from Krishna.
  19. Vv. 48–63 — cf. Murari 4.02.9–13. The brahmana Krishnadasa, by the Lord's word and power, becomes His guide through the Mathura-mandala.
  20. Vv. 65–84 — cf. Murari 4.03.3–20 (the account of the twelve forests). Distances: a yojana is about 12–13 km. "Three and a half" (vv. 76, 77, 83) is the 1903 edition's reading ("আউট"); A and B read "আট" ("eight"), apparently a corruption of the same word. Only eleven forests are named; the twelfth in Murari is Bhadra.
